guards.what: N4: `PlayerCmd.GainEnergy` (Nunchaku.cs:97) runs Hook.ModifyEnergyGain, then Hook.AfterModifyingEnergyGain, then a `finalAmount > 0` check (PlayerCmd.cs:29-43); EnergyCmd.gain (cmds.py:545-554) runs the modify chain and adds unconditionally

Recorded rather than waived because 'no ported content triggers this' is a dormant gap, not a waiver (binding rule 1).
